debrief.chart.aria: Actual balance and expected-value line over time
debrief.chart.note: The solid line is the actual balance. The dotted line is the expected-value line, built by multiplying the amount wagered by each game's average loss rate. If luck is good the solid line moves above it; if luck is bad, below.
debrief.chart.title: Flow of balance
debrief.felt.net: The net you felt was {felt} credits; the actual net was {actual} credits.
debrief.felt.none: You did not answer in the first section, so there is no value to compare. If you answer under First, how it felt above, the values will be placed side by side here.
debrief.felt.ratio: The actual time was {r} times the time you felt.
debrief.felt.time: The time you felt was {felt} min; the actual play time was {actual} min.
debrief.felt.title: Feeling and reality
debrief.help.body: If gambling worries you or feels hard to handle, you can call the Korea Gambling Problem Prevention and Treatment Center helpline, 1336.
debrief.lead: Here the balance and figures of this session are laid out together. No interpretation is added; only what is in the record is written.
debrief.mark.chase: Bet raised right after a loss
debrief.money.loss: The {credits} credits you lost equal {krw} won. Calculated with 1 credit set to {rate} won.
debrief.money.noLoss: This time {credits} credits were gained. Calculated with 1 credit set to {rate} won.
debrief.money.title: Converted to money
debrief.money.wageLoss: This is the amount earned by working about {hours} hours at the {year} minimum wage of {wage} won.
debrief.money.wageWagered: The total amount wagered during the session was {krw} won, which is about {hours} hours at the minimum wage.
debrief.nums.title: Viewed as numbers
debrief.read.afterPeak: After that you played {rounds} more rounds, wagering a total of {wagered} credits.
debrief.read.celebrations: Celebration effects appeared {n} times, and {m} of those were rounds in which you got back less than you wagered.
debrief.read.chase: You raised the bet in the same game right after losing the previous round {n} times.
debrief.read.expected: Wagering {wagered} credits, the expected value is that you lose about {exp} credits on average. The actual result was {net} credits.
debrief.read.flush: You received {n} credits all at once when the session ended, without playing rounds.
debrief.read.peak: Your balance was highest at {time}, at {peak} credits. It ended at {endTime} with {end} credits.
debrief.read.peakStart: The starting balance of {start} credits was the highest, and the session ended at {end} credits.
debrief.read.stop: You pressed the STOP button {n} times. The button had no effect on the result. The result had already been decided before you pressed it.
debrief.slotNote: Even with the same seed, slot results differ if the slot variant ({sv}) differs. Results of the other games are the same.
debrief.stat.celebratedLoss: Of which rounds where money was lost
debrief.stat.chase: Bets raised right after a loss
debrief.strip.title: When effects and actions occurred
debrief.summaryOnly: Only summary values are available right now, so the chart and the expected-value line cannot be drawn. Only the numbers that can be known from the summary are shown.
